question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

She has become a __familiar__ figure in the world of politics.
solution:
The** correct answer **is** **'**Known.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Familiar** (जाना माना): This word means well-known through experience. It suggests you've encountered something or someone often.

 
 
• **Example:** "The streets of my hometown are familiar to me."
 
 
 
• **Known** (जाना माना): This word means well-acquainted or simply aware of something or someone.
 
 
• **Example**: "The actor is known for his action movies, even though I haven't seen many."
 
 
 
• Hence, Known is the correct synonym for familiar.

Therefore, the** correct answer **is **'Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legend** (किंवदंती): Refers to a story with exaggerated elements, often about historical figures.
 
• **Elevated** (ऊंचा उठा हुआ): raised to a higher position or level.
 
• **Fancy** (मनचाहा): imaginative or elaborate.
